Film 'The Vvaan' Accused of Song Theft; Singer Claims Legal Action

The film 'The Vvaan', starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, is facing allegations of song theft. A singer has claimed that their song was used without permission and has presented evidence in a video. The vocalist has also warned of legal action.
